verdict: Prismatic Evolutions has held its value better since release: PRIS25 70.82 (100 = Jan 2025) vs DR25 58.15 (100 = May 2025) at the Sep 28 mark (−29.2% in ~20 months vs −41.9% in ~16). Same direction as the Sep 26 verdict (old Aug 24 base); the release-month base widens the gap. Latest week −4.5% vs −8.4%; since Aug 24 −6.4% vs −12.3%. Top three sold-comp medians $1,813.00 vs $740.58 (Umbreon ex SIR $1,125.00, 30 sales Sep 24–Oct 1, vs Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex SIR $412.25, 30 sales Sep 19–Oct 1). Destined Rivals is the cheaper entry: ETB lowest ask $115.00 (25 live) vs $130.00 (41 live), bundle $54.99 (44) vs $76.00 (37), Oct 2.
